description: Mayan — Colore: Fawn & silvery gold Collezione: Imago Codice: 5010 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Tribal Scala: Medium Altezza: 140 cm Rapporto: 70 cm × 69 cm Toni: Brown, Orange MAYAN is a modern interpretation of tribal design from Central America, developed from patterns in Mariano Fortuny's own textile collection. Its checkerboard grid of hatched lines alternates pyramidal forms drawn from traditional Mesoamerican shapes — mountains, rivers, rays of light, plant life — rendered in a dense ly patterned field that echoes the visual logic of ancient textiles without replicating them. The metallic stampa adds a qua lity of archaeological preservation: the forms appear as if illuminated from beneath the surface rather than printed on top of it. A distinctive, high-impact fabric for upholstery, statement wall panels, and cushion applications. Part of the IMAGO collection .
